title: Figures 20-21: Thermographic phosphor image of Model 176 fin and isodensitracer heat maps
description: Figure 20 is a black-and-white thermographic phosphor photograph of a model's fin and body at an angle of attack marked "α = 48°"; caption: "Figure 20. Thermographic Phosphor Image of Model 176 at Near-Maximum Angle of Attack." Figure 21 reproduces four contour maps of a lifting-body tail fin, with an embedded caption "FIG. 6. ISODENSITRACER maps for lifting body tail fin for four angles of attack"; caption: "Figure 21. From L/D Maximum to Maximum Angle of Attack, There is Always a Cool Sublayer Adjacent to the Wall."
